title: Natural external Cech cup with prescribed tuple coordinates
statement: Let k be a field, f:X→Spec k and g:Y→Spec k, arbitrary covers U indexed by ι and V indexed by κ, and F an X-module. For the functors of [def-sc-picard-external-right-cech-models], there is a natural transformation θ from the right tensor Cech functor to the product Cech functor. IsPicardRightCechCup f g U V F θ means that each component is the zero extension of a natural-index cochain map whose (p,q) pure-tensor coordinate on a product tuple is the tensor section of the front X section and back Y section pulled back and restricted by the canonical adjunction units. The front/back faces are those of [def-sc-cech-cup-product], and the units those of [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. No covering, finiteness, affine, quasi-coherence, exactness or homology assumption is required.

source.place: Tag 0BED, equation-kunneth-on-cech (33.29.1.1); Cohomology Tags 01FD, 07MB, 0FKV; official tag pages read

proof.text: Use the front and back faces, the pullback-unit sections and restrictions to give a bilinear pairing on every product tuple and each total summand. The tensor and product universal properties give the degree maps.

Expand the alternating differential. The shared-vertex terms cancel; the other terms give the signed Leibniz identity, so the degree maps form a cochain map. Unit, restriction and tensor-section naturality give coefficient naturality. Extend by zero. Empty index sets and zero modules obey the same formulas.
